content.en: The **World Trade Organization (WTO)** was established in 1995 following the Marrakesh Agreement, replacing the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT). It serves as a forum for governments to negotiate trade agreements and settle trade disputes. Its primary objective is to ensure that trade flows as smoothly, predictably, and freely as possible.
